en.headline: Four players share lead into final round of Link Hong Kong Open
en.dek: Thomas Pieters, John Catlin, Anirban Lahiri and Caleb Surratt are tied at 14 under after 54 holes at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling.
body: Four players share the lead heading into the final round of the 2026 Link Hong Kong Open at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling.
Thomas Pieters, John Catlin, Anirban Lahiri and Caleb Surratt are all at 14 under par after three rounds, according to tournament scores.
Local player Matthew Cheung sits two shots back at 12 under. The Asian Tour event, with a US$2 million prize fund, concludes today.
The tournament has drawn a strong international field for its 65th edition. Spectators can attend the final round, with weekend tickets required.

zh.headline: 香港公開賽決賽日四名球員並列領先
zh.dek: 湯瑪斯·彼特斯、約翰·卡特林、阿尼爾班·拉希瑞及卡勒伯·蘇拉特在粉嶺香港高爾夫球會三輪後同以低於標準十四桿並列榜首。
body: 2026年Link香港公開賽決賽日，四名球員並列領先，比賽在粉嶺香港高爾夫球會進行。
據賽事成績，湯瑪斯·彼特斯、約翰·卡特林、阿尼爾班·拉希瑞及卡勒伯·蘇拉特三輪後均以低於標準十四桿並列。
本地球員張雄熙以低於標準十二桿落後兩桿。這項亞巡賽獎金總額為200萬美元，今日完結。
賽事迎來第65屆，吸引多國好手參賽。週末入場需購票。
